activities.anchor: Ensembles carry their own expectations of structure
activities.caption: pair each ensemble with the form it was designed for
activities.name: fsEnsembleMatch

config.prompt: Before you analyse a form, ask what the ensemble was designed to do. Pair them:

pairs.right: the Classical four-movement cycle — fast, slow, minuet, fast finale
the church forms: strophic hymns, anthems, the Mass
ālāp → jōr → gat → jhālā — a form built in real time
the sama'i: four composed sections each giving way to a returning taslim refrain

config.why: A rondo logic from nineteenth-century Cairo, a four-movement conversation from Vienna — the ensemble is the casting decision under every form.

activities.anchor: Within sections, technique shapes structure at the scale of the phrase
activities.caption: file each device by the joint it makes
activities.name: fsDeviceBuckets

config.prompt: The devices are the joints of form — file each one:
buckets: word-painting — the melody draws the meaning
instrumental joints — sound marks the boundary

items.label: melisma: many notes to one syllable — the melismatic alleluias of Gregorian chant
rap's sixteen-bar verses organised by flow — the most syllabic genre there is
Weelkes's madrigal: the voices literally descend for 'descending'
a sudden shift to pizzicato closes one section and opens another
a glissando slides the music across a boundary it could not step over

config.why: These devices are the joints of form — the places where listeners, without naming it, hear a section turn.

activities.anchor: binary means two themes and ternary means three
activities.caption: true or false — the test of a form
activities.name: fsBinaryJudge

statements.s: The labels count sections, and the real test is the return.
statements.why: Listen for the homecoming, not the theme census.

statements.s: Ternary brings the entire opening section back, whole and in the tonic.
statements.why: The da capo aria and the pop song's reprise of its hook.

statements.s: Binary form typically continues in new material after moving to a related key.
statements.why: Often rounding off with a memory of A's close — but not the full homecoming.

statements.s: Rounded binary and ternary are the same thing.
statements.why: Rounded binary only recalls its ending over a continuing B idea; ternary restates the whole A section.

config.prompt: Sonata form in one movement — order the stages:
items: Exposition: first subject in the home key, transition, second subject in the dominant or relative major, codetta
Recapitulation: both subjects home, tension paid
Coda: the closing section seals the return
config.why: The engine is tonal, not just thematic: the exposition's departure in key is the problem the recapitulation's return in key solves.

activities.anchor: sonata form is a fixed mould that composers poured themes into
activities.caption: bet before you read on — the mould
activities.name: fsMouldPredict

config.q: How should sonata form be understood?
choices: A fixed mould composers pour themes into, like a cake tin
A set of shared defaults each composer negotiates with the listener
config.why: Mozart relaxes the mould; Beethoven detonates it — a recapitulation interrupted by a new-minor march in the Fifth, a fugato coda the size of a movement in the Ninth. The theory describes expectations precisely so that we can hear how brilliantly they were broken.

activities.caption: call the magnitude — the most sampled seconds in history
activities.name: fsAmenEstimate

config.prompt: The Winstons' 'Amen break' (1969) became the most sampled few seconds in history. Roughly how long is it?
config.why: Seven seconds — looped into hip-hop's raw material, with Roland's TR-808 (released 1980) supplying a grid that never tires.
config.context: A four-bar loop at 120 BPM lasts eight seconds, so a three-minute track is twenty-odd cycles of the same material.

activities.caption: find the faulty line — the producer's plan
activities.name: fsPopSpot

config.prompt: A pop producer's structural plan contains one faulty line — click it:
lines: Place the hook early — by 45 seconds, or the stream is lost.
The pre-chorus exists to create tension for the drop into chorus.
Repeat the final chorus exactly as before — repetition alone is escalation.
The bridge manages the energy curve at minute two.
config.correction: The final chorus is typically lifted — key change, added vocals, doubled drums — because repetition alone is not escalation.
config.why: Pop form is rigorously engineered, just in different units — the same three-act job as a sonata done with different tools.

activities.anchor: The cleanest analytical fun is in hybrids
activities.caption: drag the divider — the same return, two clothes
activities.name: fsHybridCompare

config.prompt: One logic, many costumes — drag the divider between two hybrids:

before.label: The sonata-rondo finale
before.text: A–B–A–C–A–B–A, home twice — the return logic of the Classical finale.

after.label: The rave anthem
after.text: Intro, build-up, drop, breakdown, final drop — sonata's tension-and-release re-derived for the dancefloor as energy and bass.

config.why: The oldest move in music — leaving and coming home — has never once worn out.
